name: Capela (Brazil)
description: Purple-blue vertical stripe at the hoist and a fly of yellow over green, charged with the municipal arms: a white shield reading CAPELA 15 08 1853 under a crown, between sugar-cane stalks.
history: Capela is a municipality in the state of Sergipe, Brazil. Portuguese Wikipedia records that in 2022 the municipality changed its flag and arms by Municipal Law No. 662/2022, the new flag being a tricolour of blue, yellow and green with a white lozenge bearing the arms; this is the earlier flag shown on Wikimedia Commons.
